comparison.objective: Candidate screens finishing media from washers; record strips 10 mm of insulation from a cable in a lever station.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests pouring and bimanual agitation of a loaded screen; record tests cable insertion, coordinated lever holding and axial extraction against blade retention.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires recovered media mass, washer retention and spill-free screen release; record requires an 8–12 mm strip, lever release and hand clearance.
comparison.reason: Coordinated cutting and axial extraction do not test granular classification.
